docs.title: Profile
docs.text: Software engineer focused on AI systems. I build production-ready AI agents and pipelines using Python, LLMs, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), with an emphasis on reliability, retrieval quality, and source-traceable answers. Currently an AI Agent Engineer at AlphaCorp AI and an M.Sc. Computer Science candidate at the University of Brasília (UnB), where I research the foundations and methods of computing.

docs.title: AI Agent Engineer — AlphaCorp AI
docs.text:
Aug 2025 – Present · Remote

Build and ship production-ready AI agents and pipelines using Python, LLMs, and RAG. Promoted from Junior AI Agent Engineer (part-time) to full-time AI Agent Engineer. Focus on agent orchestration, retrieval quality, and the infrastructure that makes LLM-driven systems dependable in production.

docs.title: AI Researcher — CEDIS (Center for Studies, Development & Innovation in Software)
docs.text:
Feb 2025 – Jan 2026 · Brasília · On-site

Led the AI layer of SEI Expert, an AI-powered system that supports the analysis of administrative processes in the Brazilian public sector. Integrated Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to deliver context-aware, source-traceable responses grounded in legal documents and process data.

Designed an MCP orchestrator that dynamically builds prompts by aggregating user-profile data, process documents, and relevant legislation — reducing analysts' cognitive load and standardizing decision-making across the organization. Delivered as a full-stack platform: a React/TypeScript frontend, a FastAPI/Python backend, and a PostgreSQL + pgvector database for semantic search.

Stack: Python · FastAPI · React · LangChain · OpenAI API · PostgreSQL · pgvector · Docker · Azure
